purpose: Record the approved proof-of-principle assumptions and the checks required before a new detector/streaming pilot. This reporting package performs no simulation, readout replay, model inference or training.
existing_results_policy: Keep every existing dataset, frozen source, model and result under its original version. The new field, source and readout geometry must not be retroactively attributed to existing results.

guidance_sources.name: Confirm detector settings and acceptance criteria (#75) · Task · lewis-group_fims.pdf
guidance_sources.evidence: Peter Lewis, 9 November 2026: proof of principle rather than deployable design; single TPC volume recommended; existing unspecified assumptions acceptable; uniform E field; B=1 T; central particle gun; x/y/timestamp in arrival sequence; possible 40 MHz master clock; no supplied event boundaries.

guidance_sources.name: image(20261112-212412).png
guidance_sources.evidence: Peter accepts the proposed E=1 kV/cm, drift speed=1 cm/us and transverse/longitudinal diffusion widths 300/200 um/sqrt(cm), at B=1 T, as proof-of-principle choices. This is not a measurement, gas-transport calculation or confirmation of Tanner's numerical derivation.

guidance_sources.name: Pasted markdown.md
guidance_sources.evidence: Prior meeting interpretation: examine 90%,95%,99% retention, classifier-score distributions and individual-event charge loss. The 95% operating point is a comparison target, not a demonstrated detector safety limit.

source_evidence.qualification: The snapshot source hashes agree with transport_reference_v2 original-source entries. The later tight100 transport adapter retains the gas field and magnetic-field value while changing vacuum integration.

active_gas.description: One gas envelope with two-end drift convention; gas slices are geometry subdivisions, not additional detectors.

source.position: uniform over the full cylindrical gas volume

verified_existing_configuration.electric_field: No explicit electric force field in the captured Geant4 field setup. Drift and diffusion are separately prescribed by the ideal readout; no numeric E is inferred from the prescribed speed.

gas.qualification: Approximate simulation material; these are implementation mass fractions, not a documented 80/20 volume mixture. No validated transport calculation ties this mixture to the prescribed drift/diffusion.

ideal_readout.readout_acceptance: radius-50 mm disk inside enclosing square; no chip gaps modeled
ideal_readout.electron_count: Poisson(edep/26 eV); stored ROOT gain10 is divided out before sampling
ideal_readout.omissions: No electronics noise, background overlay, attachment, gain fluctuations, pulse merging, threshold or deadtime model. No full drift-path wall loss.
ideal_readout.correction: The earlier conversational drift speed 0.1 cm/us was incorrect for this pinned readout; 0.01 mm/ns equals 1 cm/us.

approved_proof_of_principle_choices.source_species: electrons first; charged pions and muons as later extensions
approved_proof_of_principle_choices.scope: Generic ideal proof of principle. Acceptance does not establish a final detector design or a self-consistent gas transport calculation.

proposed_next_pilot_implementation_choic.geometry: Retain the current radius50 mm, length100 mm cylinder and generic pixel grid; make all charge drift to the positive-z readout at z=+50 mm. Do not silently enlarge to a 500 mm chamber or change to50 um pixels.
proposed_next_pilot_implementation_choic.coordinate_equivalence: The centre z=0 for coordinates [-50,50] mm is z=zmax/2=50 mm for coordinates [0,100] mm.
proposed_next_pilot_implementation_choic.field_orientation: Propose B along +z; to drift electrons toward +z, E points along -z. Direction is an implementation convention, not an additional quote from Peter.
proposed_next_pilot_implementation_choic.electric_force_implementation_gate: Declare whether E is only a nominal field associated with prescribed readout transport or is explicitly applied to Geant4 particle trajectories. Full electric force requires a validated electromagnetic equation/integrator in gas; the current magnetic-only setup cannot be relabeled as having it. Do not introduce an electric field throughout the external vacuum inadvertently.
proposed_next_pilot_implementation_choic.staged_comparison: First run unit/synthetic tests and a small fixed-seed smoke sample; then a preassigned pilot (for example 500 electron events) to inspect yields, empty events, timing, acceptance and runtime. Do not tune labels or filter events to obtain a preferred yield. No mass production in this package.
proposed_next_pilot_implementation_choic.future_physics_impact: A muon/pion dE/dx study around500 MeV/c needs new species samples and a declared estimator; existing electron-only events cannot establish that separation. Compare random loss and ML removal at matched loss budgets.

continuous_arrival_branch.existing_export: Pinned ROOT/readout replay retains pre-binning float64 arrival times, verifies every native electron field and reconstructed site map, and requires floor(arrival_time_ns/25)==original time_bin_abs. No Geant4 rerun or invented sub-bin jitter.
continuous_arrival_branch.existing_export_limit: Within-event ideal-electron records; native storage order is bin/address order rather than chronology. All electrons from a source step use the step's post-step Gtime. Event boundaries still exist in metadata; a no-boundary streaming model has not been established by this export.
continuous_arrival_branch.clocked_model_inputs: Use pixel x/y, quantized25 ns timestamp and observed arrival sequence; exclude true creation z, source/track identity, labels, event time origin and exact sub-bin time differences.
continuous_arrival_branch.same_clock_tick: Distinct underlying arrival times remain separate ordered records. A later record may see earlier records within the same tick; no record may see later arrivals.
continuous_arrival_branch.exact_time_ties: When simulated arrival times are exactly equal and physical acquisition order is unavailable, predict the tied group from one common pre-update context and update state jointly/permutation-invariantly. A lexicographic file-row tie break is not evidence of physical arrival order.
continuous_arrival_branch.exact_time_reference: Keep any model that uses unquantized times explicitly separate from the clocked model.
continuous_arrival_branch.event_boundaries: Keep event IDs only for split assignment, truth attribution and per-event evaluation. State must not reset when a hidden simulation event ID changes. Any idle-time reset or decay must depend on the observable stream only.
continuous_arrival_branch.stream_schedule: Freeze and record a truth-independent event onset schedule separately within each data split. A nonoverlapping schedule is an acceptable first pilot if labeled artificial; it does not establish behavior under pileup. Event rate/overlap has not been specified by Peter.
continuous_arrival_branch.matching: Use the same source events, split, labels, observation history and loss accounting for matched site/arrival comparisons. Report differing prediction latency: existing site models see a full current bin after it closes; causal arrivals see only preceding records.
continuous_arrival_branch.old_two_endcap_pilot: Treat endcaps as separate readout streams or retain their observable readout-plane identity; never combine equal pixel addresses across endcaps as if they were one sensor.
continuous_arrival_branch.label_policy: Initially preserve the existing microcurler/descendant/mixed-site supervision masks. Any change is a separate documented comparison.
continuous_arrival_branch.metric_policy: An ideal electron is one equal-charge record, so primary-electron count and primary charge agree there; site counts and charge need not agree. Report denominators explicitly.

pilot_acceptance_checks: Unit conversions:1 cm/us=0.01 mm/ns;1 kV/cm=100 V/mm;40 MHz=25 ns;25 ns drift corresponds to0.25 mm before diffusion, not a guaranteed spatial resolution.
One-end readout: z=-50,0,+50 mm gives unsmeared distances100,50,0 mm and delays10000,5000,0 ns; no absolute-z nearest-end formula remains.

Diffusion: sample variances in x,y and longitudinal displacement agree with D^2*d at several distances; zero-distance and boundary clipping are tested; time width follows longitudinal width divided by drift speed away from truncation.

Field/source: record actual field vector and particle vertex; geometry-overlap checks pass; changing B or E is a new source version. If explicit electric force is implemented, test charge-sign direction and work-energy change, plus integration-tolerance stability for low momentum tracks.
Readout accounting: generated=accepted+rejected; truth category counts and electron-to-site maps align; keep empty and microcurler-free events; hash all frozen inputs and outputs.

Causality: changing future arrivals cannot change earlier predictions; inserting or relabeling hidden event boundaries cannot change outputs; exact-time tied-group permutations cannot change predictions or final state.

Stream batching: one-pass and chunked inference agree while carrying state; physical history is measured in time rather than a fixed number of hits; train/validation events never share a stream or model state.

Matched metric check: project site decisions through the exact electron-to-site map and reproduce site primary-charge loss; report both pooled and equal-event recall and per-event charge-loss distributions.
No scale-up until the fixed pilot passes; new dataset/version identifiers, disjoint generation seeds and prespecified train/calibration/evaluation roles precede any new production.
